scope: Selected Android Google test-ad evidence from an isolated debug example consumer, not a production host pilot.
consumer_change: Example navigation timer changed from 8 to 240 seconds; AdConfig.splashMaxDuration remained 8 seconds. SDK source unchanged.
log_transform: Exact process and message allowlist; retain timestamp, tag and callback values; convert source success/loading markers to [success]/[loading]; remove PID/TID and other decorative Unicode symbols. Missing lines do not prove absence of requests, errors or duplicate callbacks.
image_transform: Crop Android status bar and re-encode as PNG without source metadata; no changes to ad labels or result text.
limits: Adapter nonPersonalizedAds=true is not network-level proof of npa=1 or Google serving decisions.
Rewarded Interstitial disclosure accept path only; cancel, early close, error paths and server-side verification not established by this bundle.
Historical test counts and other formats are not newly executed by this export.
Samsung Settings search was a UI observation in a tab labeled Secure Folder, not an authoritative user-150 package query; package-ID search support and tab-to-user mapping were not verified.
Two earlier live logcat captures ended with code 255 after successful installs; cause unconfirmed, selected reward/dismiss evidence remains saved.

Pixel 2026-11-22: disclosure Cancel passed. Early close without earned was NOT established: Back in countdown did not leave the ad; one Home press (~3s into countdown) produced no earned/dismissed log and a new AdManager singleton (Dart state reset, same PID) with a memory-pressure warning beforehand. Cause unverified; no earned=false callback observed.

Pixel 2026-11-22 consent: accept, Privacy Options reopen and withdraw observed once. After withdraw, Interstitial/Rewarded/RewardedInterstitial stayed idle until the 5-minute retry scan; cause not verified. Reverse path (accept after withdraw) and network-level npa=1 not established.

Pixel 2026-11-22 run 3 (Close X) is NOT a valid early-close test: run 1 tapped after reward was earned; run 2 screenshot before the tap showed no X. earned=false on early close still not observed natively.

Release/R8 (2026-11-22, Pixel): example release APK built (exit 0), launched without FATAL/ANR, but the SDK release guard for Google test ad unit IDs kept canRequestAds=false, so ad load/show under R8 was NOT exercised. Debug-signed, not a production signing or Play-delivered build.
Splash 8s cap with EEA form (2026-11-22, Pixel): one run, debug build, form waited for a human tap, not a simulated slow network.
Pixel 2026-11-23 after-fix check used the LOCAL source (path dependency, commit 35c19ea), NOT hosted 3.7.6. Withdraw reloaded all four fullscreen slots within ~1.5s once; not repeated across devices.
Pixel 2026-11-23 on LOCAL source: clearSdkData() safe scope returned normally (no TimeoutException); duration not measured; host-key preservation not tested; timeout path not exercised.

Hosted 3.7.7 (sha256 7aab5d2d22cb7ae3c3129d77ad9f2e3c5ac1c8333913cba141a3f4e0deb38984), Pixel, 2026-11-23: withdraw reloaded all four fullscreen slots in ~1.4s; clearSdkData completed in 66ms (debug build, empty-ish data, not a hang test). One accidental click on a Google test ad creative during an early-close attempt (tap coordinates came from a full-screen Close node); no install; that attempt is NOT evidence for earned=false.

Hosted 3.7.7 Pixel guarded early-close (Close node 88x84, tapped ~6.8s after show, before onEarnedReward): the ad did NOT close and the reward was still granted ~2s later; earned=false on early close is still not observable natively with this test creative. No creative click this run.

npa on the wire (Pixel, hosted 3.7.7, via Google Ads debug logging, not an external proxy): refuse run showed npa=1 on the interstitial requests, accept run showed npa absent. Only the first four fullscreen requests (App Open, Interstitial, Rewarded, Rewarded Interstitial; the log labels all of them format=interstitial_mb, told apart by slotname) of one run each; Banner/MREC/Native, later requests, accept-after-withdraw and other devices not checked.

npa mid-session withdraw (Pixel, hosted 3.7.7, GMS debug log): 4 fullscreen requests (the four fullscreen ad units) before withdraw had npa absent; the same 4 units after had npa=1. One run, fullscreen formats only, request log comes from GMS on the device, not an independent proxy.

npa on inline formats (Pixel, hosted 3.7.7, GMS debug log): after Do not consent, 2 banner, 3 MREC and 3 native requests plus the 4 fullscreen ones all carried npa=1. Refuse branch only for inline formats (no accept control run for them); banner and MREC share one ad unit, told apart by the size key; one run, one device.

npa on inline formats, accept control (Pixel, hosted 3.7.7, GMS debug log): after Consent, 2 banner, 3 MREC, 3 native and the 4 fullscreen requests all had npa absent; pairs with the refuse run. One run per branch, one device, AdMob only; still the GMS log, not an independent capture.

rdp on the wire (Pixel, hosted 3.7.7, GMS debug log): before doNotSell the first fullscreen requests had rdp absent; after doNotSell was applied the new Banner and fullscreen requests carried rdp=1. One run, one device, AdMob only, GMS log not an independent capture; the US-states UMP path and a doNotSell set before init were not exercised.
